items.myth: Average student ko scholarship nahi milti

items.detail: Leadership, field, country ya need. Criteria alag alag hote hain.
Chhoti scholarships milake bhi kharcha kaafi kam hota hai.
Shortlist banate waqt hi scholarship deadlines bhi check karo.
